잠언 28:1.content: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

잠언 28:2.content: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

잠언 28:3.content: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

잠언 28:4.content: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

잠언 28:5.content: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.

잠언 28:6.content: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

잠언 28:7.content: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

잠언 28:8.content: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

잠언 28:9.content: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

잠언 28:10.content: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

잠언 28:11.content: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

잠언 28:12.content: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

잠언 28:13.content: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

잠언 28:14.content: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

잠언 28:15.content: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

잠언 28:16.content: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

잠언 28:17.content: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

잠언 28:18.content: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

잠언 28:19.content: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

잠언 28:20.content: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

잠언 28:21.content: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

잠언 28:22.content: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

잠언 28:23.content: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

잠언 28:24.content: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

잠언 28:25.content: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.

잠언 28:26.content: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

잠언 28:27.content: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

잠언 28:28.content: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
